container: Technology has profoundly transformed society by revolutionizing communication, work, and access to information. It has connected people globally, enabled remote collaboration, and accelerated innovation. However, it has also raised concerns about privacy, job displacement, and social isolation. While enhancing efficiency and convenience, technology challenges traditional norms and demands new ethical considerations. Balancing its benefits with responsible use is essential to ensure inclusive progress and preserve human values in an increasingly digital world.
